Permissions required by samples/app-with-sp-and-secret.entra.json (mode: app, 4 resource(s))

Microsoft Graph application permissions
  Application.ReadWrite.All
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/applications/contoso-dev-web
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/applications/contoso-dev-web/federatedIdentityCredentials/github-main
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/applications/contoso-dev-web/passwordCredentials/ci-secret
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/servicePrincipals/ref(/providers/Microsoft.Entra/applications/contoso-dev-web).appId
      (Application.ReadWrite.OwnedBy would suffice for the applications this principal owns (3 resource(s)); provider)
  Organization.Read.All
      (every deployment)
      (expression lookups)
      (lookup: tenant(); preflight: GET /organization)

note: Application permissions are Microsoft Graph app roles granted (with admin consent) to the service principal EARM signs in with (AZURE_CLIENT_ID, or the managed identity). Application.ReadWrite.OwnedBy replaces Application.ReadWrite.All for applications the service principal owns.
note: 1 resource(s) have a name that depends on another resource (for example a service principal named after reference(...).appId); their permissions are computed from the declaration and the references it contains.
note: Edge permissions are listed for every relationship property the template declares (including an empty array, which removes edges). Key Vault access is an Azure RBAC / access-policy requirement of the signed-in identity, not a Graph permission.
